SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   D. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.

6. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   B. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   D. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat The School as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   C. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

11. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.

12. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Enterprise Project at School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Peace and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Child Rights and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
